fuente.titulo: Cardinal Tagle elected new Dean of College of Cardinals

titular: Cardinal Tagle named Dean of Cardinals
bajada: Filipino cardinal succeeds 92-year-old Cardinal Re in top College role
caption: Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle, Pro-Prefect of the Dicastery for Evangelization, has been elected Dean of the College of Cardinals, succeeding 92-year-old Cardinal Giovanni Battista Re. Source: Vatican News, Oct 9, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: Interior of St. Peter's Basilica with rows of empty cardinal seats, a ceremonial red biretta resting on a chair in the upper right third, left and center space open and calm.
